<DOCSTRING>
Manages user data and processes users.

This class is responsible for managing user data within the system. It provides methods to add users and process them based on their age. The primary purpose is to ensure that users are correctly added and processed, with logging to indicate whether each user is an adult or a minor.

@attribute {User[]} users - Stores the list of users. This array is initialized when the class is instantiated and is modified by the `addUser` method.

@throws {Error} - This class does not throw any errors.
</DOCSTRING>
